title: Platform engineering standup notes - 2026-03-02
content:
Platform Engineering - Standup Notes
Date: 2026-03-02
Attendees: Alex Chen (owner), Priya Singh, Jordan Lee, Maya Patel, Samir Rao (sync later)

Summary / Highlights:
- Control plane schema migration (PLAT-342) is in the final review stage; migration plan updated to include a fallback window and throttled rollout. Target: run canary migrations on staging on 2026-03-04.
- Routing policy prototype for tiered policies (latency-first, cost-first) demoed. Need follow-up to formalize API and config shape.
- Auth service (AUTH-58) token refresh bug reproduced; hotfix branch created and PR opened (#1284). QA to validate rotation behavior across Dedicated/Private.
- Quotas: multi-tenant quota enforcement tracing added. Found race condition when multiple quota update events process concurrently; root cause investigation ongoing.

Notes per area:
1) Control Plane (Alex / Priya)
- PR for schema migration: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1284 - pending two small comments.
- Migration plan includes: 1) validate schema compatibility, 2) canary rollout on 10% control-plane nodes, 3) monitor write latency + reconciliation errors for 48h, 4) automated rollback on error threshold.
- Action: Priya to add observability metrics (reconciliation_errors, migration_progress) by 2026-03-03.
- Blocker: need staging capacity reserved for canary; Samir to confirm by EOD 2026-03-02 (update: Samir OOO, confirmed 2026-03-03).

2) Routing (Jordan / Maya)
- Demo: tiered routing policies prototype supports per-customer policy overrides and region fallback. Basic rule language MVP: match -> priority(weighted) -> fallback.
- Discussion: how to express latency SLO vs cost target in rules. Suggested approach: numeric priorities + policy metadata for cost caps.
- Tasks: Jordan to write a short spec (1-pager) for the policy schema and the REST API by 2026-03-06. Maya to prototype config validation library (golang).
- Linked tickets: PLAT-349 (routing policy engine); internal RFC on Confluence.

3) Auth & Token management (Priya / Samir)
- Issue AUTH-58: token refresh race causing occasional 401s during high churn. Repro steps added to PR.
- Hotfix branch created: hotfix/auth-refresh-fix. PR #1284 opened. QA tests added to the auth-integration suite.
- Action: Priya to coordinate with SRE to schedule a short maintenance window for canary deploy on 2026-03-05 if QA passes.

4) Quotas & Billing (Maya / Alex)
- Added tracing for quota evaluation paths to help debug enforcement failures. Found a race when updating quota buckets for tenants with concurrent quota updates.
- Mitigation: introduce optimistic locking via revision numbers on quota objects as short-term. Longer-term: move to single-writer partitioning per-tenant.
- Action: Maya to implement optimistic-locking patch and open PR by 2026-03-04. Alex to prepare a capacity/latency impact sketch for the billing team.

Other items:
- Observability: Console team requested additional per-route token-level cost breakdown examples for the rollout dashboard. Jordan to coordinate with console-frontend.
- Incidents: No Sev1s this week. One mid-priority issue where a Dedicated customer saw increased tail latency in one region; traced to degraded network on host pool. SRE mitigated.
- Hiring / resourcing: interviewing for one backend engineer (platform infra) - candidates next week.

Open questions / decisions needed:
- Decision: adopt optimistic locking vs single-writer partitioning for quotas (short-term + long-term plan). Preference: implement optimistic locking now and plan partitioning work in Q2. Need confirmation from product.
- Question: Should routing policy language include explicit cost caps or leave to external signal? Engineering leans toward including a simple cost_cap field to make automated decisions easier. Product to weigh in.

Action items (owners + due dates):
- Priya: add migration observability metrics (reconciliation_errors, migration_progress) - due 2026-03-03.
- Jordan: write routing policy 1-pager + API sketch - due 2026-03-06.
- Maya: implement optimistic-lock patch for quotas and open PR - due 2026-03-04.
- Alex: prepare quota impact sketch for billing - due 2026-03-05.
- Samir: confirm staging capacity for schema canary - confirmed 2026-03-03.

Relevant links & references:
- Migration RFC / Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/987654321/Control+Plane+Routing+Design
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1284
- Linear ticket: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/PLAT-342/control-plane-schema-migrations
- Slack thread: https://redwood.slack.com/archives/C01PLATFORM/p1647342300000

Standup log snippets (quick daily feed):
- 2026-03-02 09:05 - Priya: pushed schema migration test harness updates; will add metrics.
- 2026-03-02 09:17 - Jordan: demoed routing policy prototype; feedback captured.
- 2026-03-02 09:30 - Maya: added quota tracing; reproducing race locally.
- 2026-03-02 10:00 - Alex: coordinated with billing on quota billing implications.

Notes to self / TODOs (informal):
- Sweep console integration for routing policy UI - need product wireframes.
- Check with security on auth hotfix to ensure no regression in token lifetime enforcement.
- Add more deterministic tests around quota concurrent updates.

Next standup: 2026-03-09 (weekly cadence).

Document version: draft v0.3
